title: Moving gallery/band structure to sphinx gallery
description: Moving gallery/band structure to sphinx gallery. This is part of issue #1870
diff:
diff --git a/examples/gallery/bs.py b/examples/gallery/bs.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..8aeb9c439
--- /dev/null
+++ b/examples/gallery/bs.py
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+"""
+
+Band-structure
+==============
+
+
+"""
+
+# creates: cu.png
+from ase.build import bulk
+from ase.calculators.test import FreeElectrons
+
+a = bulk('Cu')
+a.calc = FreeElectrons(nvalence=1, kpts={'path': 'GXWLGK', 'npoints': 200})
+a.get_potential_energy()
+bs = a.calc.band_structure()
+bs.plot(emin=0, emax=20, filename='cu.png')
